entities.name: Masnavi
entities.label: Text
entities.summary:
The Masnavi is an extensive Persian masnavi written by Rumi, one of the most influential works in the history of Sufism.\n
Written in the 13th century, the Masnavi is a series of six books of poetry that together amount to around 25,000 verses or 50,000 lines.\n
Rumi's masterwork is a testament to his spiritual vision, weaving together themes of love, spirituality, and social justice.\n
The Masnavi has had a profound impact on Islamic mysticism and has influenced countless writers, artists, and musicians across the world.\n
Its legacy extends beyond literature, shaping the cultural and spiritual landscape of the Middle East and beyond.\n
A closing quote encapsulates the essence of Rumi's work: 'What you seek is seeking you.'\n
